input.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import duckdb
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path

out = Path('out')
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
con = duckdb.connect()
df = con.execute("""
    SELECT year(crash_date)::INTEGER AS year,
           count(*)::INTEGER AS reported_crashes,
           sum(number_of_motorist_killed)::INTEGER AS motorist_deaths,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_motorist_killed > 0)::INTEGER AS crashes_with_motorist_death
    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
""").df()
df['motorist_fatal_crashes_per_100k_crashes'] = df['crashes_with_motorist_death'] / df['reported_crashes'] * 100000

# Option 1: fatality totals by year.
values1 = df[['year', 'motorist_deaths']].copy()
values1.to_csv(out / 'values_1.csv', index=False)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.2))
ax.plot(values1.year, values1.motorist_deaths, marker='o', color='#2864a5', linewidth=2)
ax.set(title='Motorist deaths in NYC police-reported crashes, 2013–2025',
       xlabel='Year', ylabel='Motorist deaths (count)')
ax.set_xticks(values1.year)
ax.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=.25)
ax.annotate(f"2013: {values1.motorist_deaths.iloc[0]}", (2013, values1.motorist_deaths.iloc[0]), xytext=(5, 10), textcoords='offset points')
ax.annotate(f"2025: {values1.motorist_deaths.iloc[-1]}", (2025, values1.motorist_deaths.iloc[-1]), xytext=(-42, 10), textcoords='offset points')
fig.text(.01, .01, 'Counts describe reported crashes; miles driven are not available in this dataset.', fontsize=8)
fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, .04, 1, 1))
fig.savefig(out / 'option_1.png', dpi=160)
plt.close(fig)

# Option 2: share of all reported crashes that involved at least one motorist death.
values2 = df[['year', 'reported_crashes', 'crashes_with_motorist_death', 'motorist_fatal_crashes_per_100k_crashes']].copy()
values2.to_csv(out / 'values_2.csv', index=False)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.2))
ax.plot(values2.year, values2.motorist_fatal_crashes_per_100k_crashes, marker='o', color='#b24a3a', linewidth=2)
ax.set(title='Motorist-fatal-crash incidence among reported NYC crashes, 2013–2025',
       xlabel='Year', ylabel='Crashes with motorist death per 100,000 reported crashes')
ax.set_xticks(values2.year)
ax.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=.25)
ax.annotate(f"2013: {values2.motorist_fatal_crashes_per_100k_crashes.iloc[0]:.1f}", (2013, values2.motorist_fatal_crashes_per_100k_crashes.iloc[0]), xytext=(5, 10), textcoords='offset points')
ax.annotate(f"2025: {values2.motorist_fatal_crashes_per_100k_crashes.iloc[-1]:.1f}", (2025, values2.motorist_fatal_crashes_per_100k_crashes.iloc[-1]), xytext=(-42, 10), textcoords='offset points')
fig.text(.01, .01, 'Crash-based comparison, not a per-mile risk rate; miles driven are not available.', fontsize=8)
fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, .04, 1, 1))
fig.savefig(out / 'option_2.png', dpi=160)
plt.close(fig)

print(df.to_string(index=False, formatters={'motorist_fatal_crashes_per_100k_crashes': '{:.3f}'.format}))
PY
